narrative.overview: This system exists to make bespoke software legible to the owner of a small or medium Argentine business - a comercio, consultorio, or cocina - in the seconds it takes to scroll one viewport. The owner is shown their own daily grind - stock, caja, turnos, pedidos - running as a finished, working system, and is offered one action: reach Ezequiel on WhatsApp. The page is a proof-of-work, not a promise. It refuses the abstract generic-SaaS hero: the hero shows four live dashboards that look like the owner's own counters and tickets. The aesthetic is obsidian glass over near-black charcoal, punched by an ember that is spent sparingly and always on the act of acting. Everything that states a fact is monospace; everything that narrates a human day is Inter or Plus Jakarta Sans. Depth comes from layering the ten charcoal tones and from glass that blurs chrome without occluding the ground. Precision is structural: the 1px hairline is the load-bearing ornament, and dashboards are synthetic only under an explicit demo label - the world never impersonates real data it does not have.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black charcoal ground with a ten-step tonal surface ramp; ember (#FF5722) spent only on acting states.
Working-dashboard proof language: every sector carries an operating UI mockup, not an abstract illustration.
Split-engine type: JetBrains Mono for data and caps labels, Plus Jakarta Sans for display, Inter for narrative.
Glass chrome (backdrop-blur, ~80% fill) only on fixed chrome, captions, and pills.
Rioplatense Spanish copy (voseo, pesos argentinos) that speaks the owner's problem, never the stack.
Every conversion path terminates at WhatsApp wa.me/5492213642317, centrally rerouted through src/lib/links.js.

rules.name: The Ember Fill Rule
rules.body: Warm ember #FF5722 fills only the act of acting: primary CTAs, live-pulse dots, the selected category pill, and receding ::selection. Everywhere else the palette stays charcoal, salmon, or cyan. A screen with more than one ember-filled block beyond its CTA is off-system.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px borders in surface-container-highest - never heavier, never brighter. The single sanctioned exception is the 2px dashed outline-variant connector between steps in the Automatizar pipeline.

rules.name: The Mono Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono speaks only machine truth: numbers, statuses, labels, endpoints, prices. Human narrative and persuasion (headlines, promises, questions) never render in mono, and data never renders in the display face.

rules.name: The Glass-Stays-Thin Rule
rules.body: Glass is never doubled and never buoyant: one blurred layer at ~80% fill on fixed chrome, captions, and pills. If a surface casts a real shadow it is not glass - it is a panel, and panels use the charcoal ladder instead.

dos: Do sell the owner's day (stock, caja, turnos, pedidos) in rioplatense voseo - never the stack in user-facing copy.
Do prove with a working dashboard: every sector and the hero itself carries an operating UI, not an illustration.
Do spend the ember fill only on action, and let the charcoal ladder + hairline carry everything else.
Do make data speak mono and persuasion speak Inter/Plus Jakarta Sans; keep label-caps uppercase.
Do label every synthetic figure: a DemoTag on each fabricated panel and the hero footnote 'Datos de los paneles: demo ilustrativo hasta confirmar cifras reales.'
Do route every conversion through WhatsApp with a prefilled sector message from src/lib/links.js.
Do keep micro demo sizes (10-11px mono) inside mockup wells only; the shipped body ramp starts at 13px.
donts: Don't speak English or developer-market language to this audience - no 'full-stack', no 'uptime' as a value claim, no fabricated testimonials or client results.
Don't present invented figures (revenue, percentages, order numbers, uptime) without the demo marker.
Don't add cast shadows to glass, double up the blur, or brighten hairlines past surface-container-highest.
Don't widen borders: structure is 1px, except the sanctioned 2px dashed flow connector.
Don't add new icon grammars: glyphs are Material Symbols Outlined from Google Fonts.
Don't invent new surface tones outside the recorded @theme ladder; the neutral story is the ten charcoal steps.
